profile_text.body:
Baidu Research is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Beijing, China, according to its profile. Its website is research.baidu.com. The site text currently reads "百度研究院 - 网站维护中", a notice that the Baidu Research website is under maintenance, so no description of its work, teams, or research areas is available from the site itself.

The profile records no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Baidu Research. Beyond its name, location, for-profit status, and research-lab classification, no further detail is available.
